Cammareri Bros. rosemary focaccia.d: Olive oil bread from sheet pans, dimpled, with coarse salt. Slices .75
Cammareri Bros. rosemary focaccia.note: Rosary Society bake sale, after every Mass.

Eggs in the hole.d: Thick white toast fried in butter with a ring of red pepper, the yolk left soft in the middle.
Eggs in the hole.note: Holy Name communion breakfast, after the 9.

Chicken scaloppine.d: Cutlets pounded thin, floured and sautéed with lemon, white wine, capers and butter.
Chicken scaloppine.note: Bella Luna dinner dance, Saturday at 7.

Cannoli.d: Sweet ricotta and grated orange peel, ends dipped in chocolate. Filled to order.
Cannoli.note: One dollar each at the bake sale.

Brooklyn amaretto sours.d: Shaken frothy with lemon and egg white, over ice, with a cherry.
Brooklyn amaretto sours.note: Cash bar at the dinner dance.
